verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook documents exporting notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets. It also documents downloading flashcards as CSV, sharing slide decks as PDF, and downloading infographics as PNG, which covers the document and spreadsheet parts of the story. There is no evidence of any reference-manager export. Missing for 10: reference-manager file export (e.g. BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), export of chat results or reports to standard file formats beyond Google Workspace, independent or hands-on corroboration of export quality.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files

citations.quote: You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.
Download your flashcards as a CSV file.
Present your deck instantly in Gemini Notebook or share it as a PDF.
